svg.title: AlgoGalaxy: An online judge for competitive programming, built from scratch. Run and submit C++, Java, Python and JavaScript against test cases, with a verdict per case. Email-verified signup and JWT sessions in httpOnly cookies. Community problem contributions reviewed by moderators; admin dashboard for users and problems. Zod-validated API routes on Next.js 14 and MongoDB, containerized with Docker.
